author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಶೃತಿಗಳಿವೆ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವಿವೆ ಉಪನಿಷದಗಳಿವೆ
ಕೃತಿಗಳಲಳವಡಿಸೆ ಜೀವನವೆ ಧನ್ಯ
ಧೃತಿಸ್ಮೃತಿ ಜೊತೆಗೂಡೆ ನ್ಯಾಯನೀತಿಯ ನಡೆ
ಕೃತಕರ್ಮ ರಕ್ಷಿಪುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: There are the Vedas, the śāstras, the Upaniṣads;
if you bring them into your deeds, life is blessed;
when fortitude and memory join a walk of justice and right,
the deeds you have done will protect you, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Scripture is plentiful; what matters is living it. Steadfastness, remembrance of the teaching and just conduct together make our own deeds our protection.
